review_text: I've been ordering their brownies here for a long time and they are still as delicious as I remember. Anniepie is one of those places I keep coming back to because of the consistent taste. The service and atmosphere are just average, but the food makes up for it. Overall, I really enjoy Anniepie, not just for the brownies but their other food options as well.

I have been to two other Annipies for food and drink but only came to this one for coffees to go. It was clean and the staff was friendly and helpful and packaged up my coffees very well for my walk home. I ordered a White Cinnamon Latte and an Iced Tiramisu Macchiato. Couldn't wait to get home and try them and I was very pleased with both. Excellent coffee! The CR was clean and they have WiFi!

We loved the food and the place, needs to improve the parking space. 2 star ratings sa service kasi hindi kami na heads-up na may shrimp yung carbonara, as someone na allergic sa seafood, nagulat ako, buti may dala kaming meds. Next time, either write allergens on the menu or tell customers about it when ordering. Also, don't serve utensils on the plate touching the food, it's very unhygienic.

Overall, not ok for me. But if there were other options when we were in the area, I wouldn't go back... So far, the vibe at this branch is pretty OFF. We've been going for a long time, we've been there twice because we had to because we were being treated by Davao Doc. They're feb teachers. So we had no choice, no close friends. Do they charge a service fee? But the service? You're polite, the least you expect is to look at you while you're eating? But no, the vibe is really bad because you feel like you're bothering to order. That's it. Then, you ask for water. I understand if they ever don't serve free water, they'll still have it. But at least they'll inform us if we need any drinks for the mean time, isn't that the basic thing? They're not fast food, so idk. Other branches are good, especially Ayala and the Airport. Then one of the things I don't like is that they just put the food on the side. Like huh? It's okay if you buy and serve because there are different orders on the table, but they put it on the side... Like, huh? 🤨 I even ask most of the others if they have chocolate pudding, if they have tiramisu, and all that basic sht. But they're like, "ok I've put it, bye I'm out" Anyway, their food is okay. It's just annoying to make you feel like you're bothering them and then you have to pay a service fee. Lol. That's it. good luck 👍
